text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "Read Uncommitted behaves like Read Committed in PostgreSQL",
      "claim_text": "In PostgreSQL, Read Uncommitted behaves like Read Committed.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P0.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a transaction that requests Read Uncommitted never sees uncommitted data",
      "claim_text": "A transaction that requests Read Uncommitted never sees uncommitted data.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P1.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "it never sees either uncommitted data"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Read Uncommitted behaves like Read Committed, which never sees uncommitted data."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Both Repeatable Read and Serializable may require the application to retry transactions",
      "claim_text": "Both Repeatable Read and Serializable may require the application to retry transactions.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S2 says Serializable, like Repeatable Read, may require retries."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "A transaction that requested Serializable on PostgreSQL 9.0 could still run into serialization anomalies",
      "claim_text": "A transaction that requested Serializable on PostgreSQL 9.0 could still run into serialization anomalies.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P3.S2", "rel": "entails", "sub": "except for serialization anomalies"}
      ],
      "check": {"kind": "version", "left": "9.0", "op": "<", "right": "9.1"},
      "reasoning": "Before 9.1, Serializable behaved like Repeatable Read, which allows serialization anomalies."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Serializable adds extra blocking compared with Repeatable Read",
      "claim_text": "Serializable adds extra blocking compared with Repeatable Read.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S4", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "does not introduce any blocking beyond that present in repeatable read"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S4 explicitly says no extra blocking."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "which is why it is slower",
      "claim_text": "Serializable is slower than Repeatable Read.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passages mention overhead but not that it is slower."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Because predicate locks never block, Serializable transactions can never raise an error that would not occur in a serial execution",
      "claim_text": "Serializable transactions can never raise an error that would not occur in a serial execution.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S0", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "it doesn't always prevent errors from being raised that would not occur in true serial execution"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P7.S0 says such errors can occur."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Read Committed and Repeatable Read transactions that need consistency may have to lock an entire table",
      "claim_text": "Read Committed and Repeatable Read transactions that need consistency may have to lock an entire table.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P6.S3."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "which can block other users",
      "claim_text": "Locking an entire table can block other users.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S3", "rel": "entails", "sub": "which could block other users"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P6.S3 states this."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Repeatable Read is faster than Serializable in every workload",
      "claim_text": "Repeatable Read is faster than Serializable in every workload.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passages do not compare speed across workloads."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Under Read Committed, later commands in the same transaction see the effects of concurrent transactions that have committed",
      "claim_text": "Under Read Committed, later commands in the same transaction see the effects of concurrent transactions that have committed.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P2.S0."
    }
  ]
}
